rejectedTourismIntensity.notes: Seoul Metropolitan Government's published tourist-arrival series estimates foreign visitors to Seoul by applying Seoul's share to Korea-wide inbound visitors, so it excludes domestic overnight visitors. The Seoul Data Hub mobility series counts broad movements into tourist-area grids, includes domestic residents and long- and short-term foreigners, and does not isolate overnight arrivals. Retain tourism intensity as pending rather than treating foreign-only arrivals or broad mobility visits as the registered all-overnight-arrivals numerator.

tourismIntensity.spatialUnit: Capital City of Prague administrative region

tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Residents of the Capital City of Prague at 31 December 2024
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Czech Statistical Office, First Hand Figures Prague 2024
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: Czech Statistical Office, Population movement in Prague in 2024
tourismIntensity.notes: The numerator covers registered collective accommodation establishments and therefore excludes some small, informal, or platform-only stays; it is a reproducible lower-bound proxy for overnight arrivals, not total visitation.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Tourists in Barcelona city tourist accommodation during 2024, according to available accommodation-series data
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Residents of Barcelona city municipality in 2024
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Barcelona Tourism Observatory, Barcelona tourism activity report 2024
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: Barcelona City Council, demographic indicators reproduced in Barcelona tourism activity report 2024
tourismIntensity.notes: The report labels the tourist total as according to data availability across tourist-accommodation series; it is retained as a reproducible accommodation-based proxy rather than an exhaustive count of all overnight visitors.

tourismIntensity.spatialUnit: Ciudad de Mexico federal entity (all 16 boroughs)
tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Tourists staying in Ciudad de Mexico hotels during 2023
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Projected mid-year population of Ciudad de Mexico in 2023, summed across both sexes and all 16 boroughs
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Secretaria de Turismo de la Ciudad de Mexico, Sixth Tourism Report
tourismIntensity.notes: The numerator covers registered hotel tourists and therefore excludes stays in other accommodation, with friends or relatives, and some platform inventory. It is retained as a same-geography, reproducible lower-bound proxy for overnight arrivals rather than total visitation.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Estimated overnight tourists visiting Fukuoka city during 2023
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Estimated population of Fukuoka city on 1 October 2023
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Fukuoka City, Tourism and MICE Statistics 2025 edition
tourismIntensity.notes: The city publishes the overnight-tourist estimate rounded to the nearest 10,000. Its methodology combines Fukuoka tax statistics and the Japan Tourism Agency accommodation survey, then applies an overnight-tourist rate derived from city visitor surveys; retain the resulting ratio as an estimated tourism-pressure proxy rather than an exact census of guests.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Guests staying in surveyed accommodation across all four Sendai city tourism districts during 2024
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Residents registered in Sendai city at year-end 2024
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Sendai City Tourism Strategy Division, 2024 Basic Tourism Statistics
tourismIntensity.notes: The citywide total is the published sum of the old Sendai, Miyagi, Izumi, and Akiu districts. The source explicitly excludes private lodging (minpaku), so the numerator is retained as a reproducible registered-accommodation lower bound rather than exhaustive overnight visitation.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Tourist arrivals at commercial, private, and other tourist accommodation establishments in Budapest during 2024
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Resident population of Budapest capital region on 1 January 2024
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Hungarian Central Statistical Office, tourist arrivals by county and region
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: Hungarian Central Statistical Office, resident population by sex, county and region
tourismIntensity.notes: The numerator covers registered commercial, private, and other tourist accommodation establishments and includes domestic and international arrivals. The denominator is the start-of-year resident population for the same capital-region geography.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Arrivals in categorized accommodation establishments with 10 or more bed places in Sofia capital district during 2024
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Population of Sofia (Stolitsa) capital district at 31 December 2024
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Bulgarian National Statistical Institute, accommodation establishments annual time series
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: Bulgarian National Statistical Institute, District Sofia (Stolitsa) key indicators
tourismIntensity.notes: The numerator includes resident and non-resident arrivals but only at categorized accommodation establishments with at least 10 bed places. Smaller and informal stays are outside the frame, so the result is a reproducible lower-bound proxy for overnight arrivals.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Arrivals for an overnight stay at Ministry-certified tourism-operation and simple-accommodation establishments in Istanbul province during 2023
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Residents of Istanbul province at 31 December 2023
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Istanbul Provincial Directorate of Culture and Tourism, December 2024 tourism statistics report
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: TurkStat, Address Based Population Registration System results 2023
tourismIntensity.notes: The numerator includes domestic and international arrivals at registered Ministry-certified accommodation but counts establishment entries rather than unique people: repeat stays by the same tourist are separate arrivals. Informal and other out-of-frame stays are excluded, so the result is a reproducible accommodation-pressure proxy rather than total unique visitation.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Registered tourist arrivals in the City of Dubrovnik recorded by the eVisitor system during 2024
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Estimated population of the City of Dubrovnik administrative area at 31 December 2024
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: Croatian Bureau of Statistics PxWeb, population estimate by towns and municipalities at 31 December
tourismIntensity.notes: The numerator is an eVisitor registration count covering commercial and non-commercial accommodation. It records arrivals rather than unique tourists, so a guest who changes establishment can be registered more than once. The very high ratio is retained as a measured tourism-pressure signal for the same municipal boundary, not interpreted as unique visitors per resident.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Registered domestic and international tourist arrivals in the City of Split recorded by the eVisitor system during 2024
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Estimated population of the City of Split administrative area at 31 December 2024
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Split Tourist Board, statistical analysis of tourism in Split during 2024
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: Croatian Bureau of Statistics PxWeb, population estimate by towns and municipalities at 31 December
tourismIntensity.notes: The numerator is the Tourist Board's eVisitor extract processed on 27 January 2025 and includes both domestic and international registered arrivals. Subsequent registrations can revise eVisitor totals, and establishment changes can count the same tourist more than once; retain it as a reproducible accommodation-pressure proxy rather than a unique-person count.

tourismIntensity.spatialUnit: City and County of San Francisco
tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Modelled domestic and international visitors staying at least one night in San Francisco during 2023
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Estimated resident population of San Francisco County on 1 July 2023

tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2023 Population Estimates Program

It is a rounded model estimate derived from lodging, transport, attraction, economic, and visitor-survey inputs; unlike accommodation-register counts it also covers vacation rentals and stays with friends or family. Retain 8.00 million as published precision, not an exact administrative count.

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Guests recorded in tourist accommodation establishments located in Lisbon municipality during 2023
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Estimated resident population of Lisbon municipality in 2023

tourismIntensity.numeratorDefinition: Total monthly overnight visitation to Vancouver during 2024
tourismIntensity.denominatorDefinition: Estimated resident population of Vancouver municipality on 1 July 2024
tourismIntensity.arrivalsSourceName: Destination Vancouver, Research & Insights overnight visitation series
tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: BC Stats, Municipalities (Census Subdivisions) population estimates

The denominator is BC Stats' total-gender 2024 estimate for Vancouver municipality (region 15022). The numerator is a destination-series measure rather than an accommodation-register count, and the public page does not expose detailed model methodology inline.
